authority: Frozen phase1 source census plus parent-supplied tier helper; completed before candidate annotation reads.
tier_rule: 2 if value > high else 1 if value > moderate else 0
dimensions_census_units: Semantic units are declared, not a claim of universal atom cardinality. Component responsibilities count requested system surfaces. Paths count complete journeys.
coverage_note: Zero high cases is a prospective annotation coverage gap; this assessment makes no product or release qualification claim.

Non-goals use the frozen census semantic exclusion units; overlapping safety constraints are not extra safety counts.
Five named product systems remain product scope even where exact responsibility-to-action mapping is not prescribed.
